description: This file defines database entity classes for an Android app using Room persistence library. It contains data classes representing tables for calendar events, leaves, and astrology details, each annotated with @Entity and with primary keys specified.

classes.name: CalendarEventEntity
classes.description: Represents a calendar event with fields like id, title, description, start and end times, type, and last modified timestamp.

classes.name: LeaveEntity
classes.description: Represents leave information with fields such as id, title, description, start and end dates, type, and last modified timestamp.

classes.name: AstrologyEntity
classes.description: Stores astrology-related data including id, date, raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, special notes, and last modified timestamp.
